summary_en: This Phase 2 study tests talazoparib with androgen deprivation therapy and abiraterone in men with castration-sensitive prostate cancer. Talazoparib, abiraterone acetate, and prednisone are taken by mouth once daily on days 1-28 of each 28-day cycle, and androgen deprivation therapy is given as injections (degarelix, leuprolide acetate) or goserelin under the skin, with bicalutamide taken by mouth in some arms. Cycles repeat every 28 days while the disease does not progress and side effects are acceptable, and the total length of treatment is not stated. The main outcome measure is not stated in the record; the study is labeled Phase 2.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 evalúa talazoparib con terapia de privación androgénica y abiraterona en hombres con cáncer de próstata sensible a la castración. Talazoparib, acetato de abiraterona y prednisona se toman por vía oral una vez al día en los días 1 a 28 de cada ciclo de 28 días, y la terapia de privación androgénica se administra mediante inyecciones (degarelix, acetato de leuprolida) o acetato de goserelina bajo la piel, con bicalutamida por vía oral en algunos grupos. Los ciclos se repiten cada 28 días mientras la enfermedad no progrese y los efectos secundarios sean aceptables, y la duración total del tratamiento no se indica. La medida de resultado principal no se indica en el registro; el estudio está clasificado como fase 2.
who_for: Prostate adenocarcinoma confirmed by biopsy or cytology
Metastatic disease (soft tissue and/or bone) before androgen treatment started
Hormone therapy for metastatic disease started no more than 60 days before registration, with other prior hormone therapy limits
Adequate liver, kidney, and blood counts within 28 days before registration
not_for: Prior or planned ketoconazole, aminoglutethimide, or enzalutamide
Prior cytotoxic chemotherapy for metastatic prostate cancer
New York Heart Association class III or IV heart failure, or certain heart events within 6 months
Known HIV, active hepatitis B or C, or primary or secondary adrenal insufficiency
